say:1:1033714001:1.text: I don't have hard feelings towards them anymore.
say:1:1033714001:1.source_cn: 排斥？不，还没有到那个地步。
say:1:1033714001:1.male: I don't have hard feelings towards them anymore.
say:1:1033714001:1.female: I don't have hard feelings towards them anymore.

say:2:1033714002:1.text: It's true that they made quite a few mistakes while handling this corruption.
say:2:1033714002:1.source_cn: 这次的腐化中，荆棘的所作所为确实有很多不妥的地方。
say:2:1033714002:1.male: It's true that they made quite a few mistakes while handling this corruption.
say:2:1033714002:1.female: It's true that they made quite a few mistakes while handling this corruption.

say:3:1033714003:1.text: But they were being deceived by Eomir.
say:3:1033714003:1.source_cn: 但他们也是受到了伊米尔的蛊惑。
say:3:1033714003:1.male: But they were being deceived by Eomir.
say:3:1033714003:1.female: But they were being deceived by Eomir.

say:4:1033714004:1.text: They're working hard to make up for their mistakes now, so I hold no grudges against them.
say:4:1033714004:1.source_cn: 现在的他们也在为自己所犯下的错误尽力弥补，所以我不会排...
say:4:1033714004:1.male: They're working hard to make up for their mistakes now, so I hold no grudges against them.
say:4:1033714004:1.female: They're working hard to make up for their mistakes now, so I hold no grudges against them.
